use std::panic::{AssertUnwindSafe, catch_unwind, panic_any, resume_unwind};
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicUsize, Ordering};
use std::future::Future;

unsafe extern "C" {
    fn probe_begin();
    fn probe_end() -> i32;
}

// Instrument rustc's allocator through the same C wrappers used by the Flux
// object's allocator imports. The test body and panic paths are identical.
#[cfg(rust_control)]
mod allocator {
    use std::alloc::{GlobalAlloc, Layout};
    unsafe extern "C" {
        fn probe_layout_alloc(size: usize, align: usize, zero: i32) -> *mut u8;
        fn probe_layout_realloc(pointer: *mut u8, old_size: usize, align: usize, size: usize) -> *mut u8;
        fn flux_free_probe(pointer: *mut u8);
    }
    struct Tracked;
    unsafe impl GlobalAlloc for Tracked {
        unsafe fn alloc(&self, layout: Layout) -> *mut u8 {
            unsafe { probe_layout_alloc(layout.size(), layout.align(), 0) }
        }
        unsafe fn alloc_zeroed(&self, layout: Layout) -> *mut u8 {
            unsafe { probe_layout_alloc(layout.size(), layout.align(), 1) }
        }
        unsafe fn dealloc(&self, pointer: *mut u8, _: Layout) {
            unsafe { flux_free_probe(pointer); }
        }
        unsafe fn realloc(&self, pointer: *mut u8, layout: Layout, size: usize) -> *mut u8 {
            unsafe { probe_layout_realloc(pointer, layout.size(), layout.align(), size) }
        }
    }
    #[global_allocator]
    static ALLOCATOR: Tracked = Tracked;
}

static DROPS: AtomicUsize = AtomicUsize::new(0);
struct Guard(bool);
impl Drop for Guard {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        DROPS.fetch_add(1, Ordering::SeqCst);
        if self.0 { panic!("destructor panic"); }
    }
}
trait Marker {}
impl Marker for Guard {}

fn direct_box() {
    assert!(catch_unwind(|| {
        let value = Box::new([7u64; 128]);
        std::hint::black_box(&*value);
        panic!("box scope");
    }).is_err());
}
fn dynamic_box() {
    assert!(catch_unwind(|| {
        let value: Box<dyn Marker> = Box::new(Guard(false));
        std::hint::black_box(&*value);
        panic!("dynamic box scope");
    }).is_err());
    assert_eq!(DROPS.load(Ordering::SeqCst), 1);
}
fn dynamic_destructor() {
    assert!(catch_unwind(|| {
        let value: Box<dyn Marker> = Box::new(Guard(true));
        drop(value);
    }).is_err());
    assert_eq!(DROPS.load(Ordering::SeqCst), 1);
}
fn boxed_once() {
    assert!(catch_unwind(|| {
        let guard = Box::new(Guard(false));
        let callback: Box<dyn FnOnce()> = Box::new(move || {
            let _guard = guard;
            panic!("boxed callback");
        });
        callback();
    }).is_err());
    assert_eq!(DROPS.load(Ordering::SeqCst), 1);
}
fn cancellation() {
    let mut future = Box::pin(async {
        let _guard = Box::new(Guard(true));
        std::future::pending::<()>().await;
    });
    let mut context = std::task::Context::from_waker(std::task::Waker::noop());
    assert!(future.as_mut().poll(&mut context).is_pending());
    assert!(catch_unwind(AssertUnwindSafe(|| drop(future))).is_err());
    assert_eq!(DROPS.load(Ordering::SeqCst), 1);
}
fn poisoned_frame() {
    let mut future = Box::pin(async {
        let _guard = Box::new(Guard(false));
        panic!("poll panic");
    });
    let mut context = std::task::Context::from_waker(std::task::Waker::noop());
    assert!(catch_unwind(AssertUnwindSafe(|| future.as_mut().poll(&mut context))).is_err());
    assert!(catch_unwind(AssertUnwindSafe(|| future.as_mut().poll(&mut context))).is_err());
    drop(future);
    assert_eq!(DROPS.load(Ordering::SeqCst), 1);
}
struct Payload([u64; 32]);
impl Drop for Payload {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        assert!(!std::thread::panicking());
        assert_eq!(self.0[17], 19);
        DROPS.fetch_add(1, Ordering::SeqCst);
    }
}
fn payload_resume() {
    let error = catch_unwind(|| panic_any(Payload([19; 32]))).unwrap_err();
    let address = error.downcast_ref::<Payload>().unwrap() as *const Payload as usize;
    let error = catch_unwind(AssertUnwindSafe(|| resume_unwind(error))).unwrap_err();
    assert_eq!(error.downcast_ref::<Payload>().unwrap() as *const Payload as usize, address);
    drop(error);
    assert_eq!(DROPS.load(Ordering::SeqCst), 1);
}
fn formatted_payload() {
    let error = catch_unwind(|| {
        let message = String::from("owned formatting input");
        panic!("formatted {message}");
    }).unwrap_err();
    assert_eq!(error.downcast_ref::<String>().unwrap(), "formatted owned formatting input");
    drop(error);
}
fn normal_return() {
    let input = String::from("owned return value");
    let value = catch_unwind(move || input).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(value, "owned return value");
    drop(value);
}
fn partial_array() {
    fn make(fail: bool) -> Box<Guard> {
        if fail { panic!("partial box array"); }
        Box::new(Guard(false))
    }
    assert!(catch_unwind(|| {
        let _values = [make(false), make(true)];
    }).is_err());
    assert_eq!(DROPS.load(Ordering::SeqCst), 1);
}
fn aligned_box() {
    #[repr(align(64))]
    struct Aligned([u8; 33]);
    assert!(catch_unwind(|| {
        let value = Box::new(Aligned([7; 33]));
        assert_eq!(&*value as *const Aligned as usize % 64, 0);
        std::hint::black_box(&value.0);
        panic!("aligned box");
    }).is_err());
}
fn slice_destructor() {
    assert!(catch_unwind(|| {
        let values = vec![Guard(true), Guard(false), Guard(false)].into_boxed_slice();
        drop(values);
    }).is_err());
    assert_eq!(DROPS.load(Ordering::SeqCst), 3);
}
fn vector_destructor() {
    assert!(catch_unwind(|| drop(vec![Guard(true), Guard(false), Guard(false)])).is_err());
    assert_eq!(DROPS.load(Ordering::SeqCst), 3);
}
fn iterator_destructor() {
    let mut values = vec![Guard(false), Guard(true), Guard(false)].into_iter();
    drop(values.next());
    assert!(catch_unwind(AssertUnwindSafe(|| drop(values))).is_err());
    assert_eq!(DROPS.load(Ordering::SeqCst), 3);
}
fn arc_destructor() {
    let value: std::sync::Arc<dyn Marker> = std::sync::Arc::new(Guard(true));
    let weak = std::sync::Arc::downgrade(&value);
    assert!(catch_unwind(AssertUnwindSafe(|| drop(value))).is_err());
    assert!(weak.upgrade().is_none());
    drop(weak);
    assert_eq!(DROPS.load(Ordering::SeqCst), 1);
}
fn rc_destructor() {
    let value: std::rc::Rc<dyn Marker> = std::rc::Rc::new(Guard(true));
    assert!(catch_unwind(AssertUnwindSafe(|| drop(value))).is_err());
    assert_eq!(DROPS.load(Ordering::SeqCst), 1);
}
fn queue_destructor() {
    let mut values = std::collections::VecDeque::new();
    values.push_back(Guard(true));
    values.push_back(Guard(false));
    values.push_back(Guard(false));
    assert!(catch_unwind(AssertUnwindSafe(|| drop(values))).is_err());
    assert_eq!(DROPS.load(Ordering::SeqCst), 3);
}
fn list_destructor() {
    let mut values = std::collections::LinkedList::new();
    values.push_back(Guard(true));
    values.push_back(Guard(false));
    values.push_back(Guard(false));
    assert!(catch_unwind(AssertUnwindSafe(|| drop(values))).is_err());
    assert_eq!(DROPS.load(Ordering::SeqCst), 3);
}
fn main() {
    std::panic::set_hook(Box::new(|_| {}));
    // Initialize any persistent panic/TLS state before measuring live storage.
    assert!(catch_unwind(|| panic!("warmup")).is_err());
    for case in [direct_box as fn(), dynamic_box, dynamic_destructor, boxed_once,
        cancellation, poisoned_frame, payload_resume, formatted_payload,
        normal_return, partial_array, aligned_box, slice_destructor,
        vector_destructor, iterator_destructor, arc_destructor,
        rc_destructor, queue_destructor, list_destructor] {
        DROPS.store(0, Ordering::SeqCst);
        unsafe { probe_begin(); }
        case();
        assert_eq!(unsafe { probe_end() }, 1, "all measured allocations must be released exactly once");
    }
    println!("allocation release passed");
}
